'Circuit-&hellip;breaker&hellip;module&hellip;'|[[Dromboid]], hosting an [[instruction cassette]]|<ref name="The Star Wars Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>}}
The '''circuit-breaker module''' was a component in the construction of [[mini-transmitter]]s, devices that converted speech into other [[Language/Legends|languages]]. One [[Unidentified Amorphiian company|Amorphiian company]] sold a brand of mini-transmitter during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that included a circuit-breaker module.<ref name="The Star Wars Holiday Special" />
